views.name: datasets_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "CreatorUserId" AS creator_user_id,
       "OwnerUserId" AS owner_user_id,
       "OwnerOrganizationId" AS owner_organization_id,
       "CurrentDatasetVersionId" AS current_dataset_version_id,
       "CurrentDatasourceVersionId" AS current_datasource_version_id,
       "ForumId" AS forum_id,
       "Type" AS type,
       -- CreationDate is NUMBER(38,0) (epoch-like). Convert to TIMESTAMP_LTZ safely by interpreting as seconds if plausible.
       -- If CreationDate represents milliseconds uncomment the *1000/1000000 adjustments as needed.
       TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(TRY_TO_DECIMAL("CreationDate")) AS creation_ts,
       -- LastActivityDate is DATE; cast to TIMESTAMP_LTZ preserving date
       CAST("LastActivityDate" AS TIMESTAMP_LTZ) AS last_activity_ts,
       COALESCE("TotalViews", 0) AS total_views,
       COALESCE("TotalDownloads", 0) AS total_downloads,
       COALESCE("TotalVotes", 0) AS total_votes,
       COALESCE("TotalKernels", 0) AS total_kernels
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.DATASETS
views.description: Canonicalized dataset-level relation. Use when you need one row per dataset with its identifying keys, creator/owner ids, version references and basic engagement metrics. Good starting point for joins to tags, versions, kernels or analytics. | Use for: Top datasets by views/downloads/votes; Join datasets to tags/versions/kernels; Time-based analysis of dataset creation or activity

views.name: dataset_tags
views.body_sql:
SELECT dt."Id" AS id,
       dt."DatasetId" AS dataset_id,
       dt."TagId" AS tag_id,
       t."Name" AS tag_name,
       t."Slug" AS tag_slug,
       t."FullPath" AS tag_full_path
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.DATASETTAGS dt
LEFT JOIN META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.TAGS t
  ON dt."TagId" = t."Id"
views.description: Dataset-to-tag assignments with tag metadata. One row per dataset-tag link enriched with tag name/slug. Use when analyzing tag distributions, filtering datasets by tag, or aggregating metrics by tag. | Use for: Count datasets by tag; Filter datasets that have a specific tag or tag hierarchy; Join tag metadata into dataset-level analytics

views.name: kernel_versions_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "AuthorUserId" AS author_user_id,
       "ScriptId" AS script_id,
       "ScriptLanguageId" AS script_language_id,
       "ParentScriptVersionId" AS parent_script_version_id,
       "VersionNumber" AS version_number,
       "IsChange" AS is_change,
       "Title" AS title,
       -- CreationDate is stored as NUMBER; convert from epoch seconds to TIMESTAMP_LTZ
       TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(COALESCE("CreationDate",0)) AS creation_ts,
       -- EvaluationDate is a DATE; cast to TIMESTAMP_LTZ for consistency (nulls preserved)
       CAST("EvaluationDate" AS TIMESTAMP_LTZ) AS evaluation_ts,
       COALESCE("TotalLines",0) AS total_lines,
       COALESCE("TotalVotes",0) AS total_votes,
       COALESCE("LinesChangedFromPrevious",0) AS lines_changed_from_previous,
       COALESCE("LinesInsertedFromPrevious",0) AS lines_inserted_from_previous,
       COALESCE("LinesDeletedFromFork",0) AS lines_deleted_from_fork,
       COALESCE("LinesChangedFromFork",0) AS lines_changed_from_fork,
       COALESCE("LinesInsertedFromFork",0) AS lines_inserted_from_fork,
       COALESCE("LinesUnchangedFromPrevious",0) AS lines_unchanged_from_previous
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELVERSIONS
views.description: One row per kernel version (historical/version entry) with key attributes and code-change metrics. Useful for version history, author/time based analyses, and joining to kernels or kernel-related votes/links. | Use for: Identify most active authors by kernel-version counts; Compute average lines changed per version; Join versions to kernels, votes, or dataset/competition sources

views.name: kernels_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "AuthorUserId" AS author_user_id,
       "CurrentKernelVersionId" AS current_kernel_version_id,
       "ForkParentKernelVersionId" AS fork_parent_kernel_version_id,
       "FirstKernelVersionId" AS first_kernel_version_id,
       "ForumTopicId" AS forum_topic_id,
       "CreationDate" AS creation_date_raw,
       CAST("EvaluationDate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS evaluation_ts,
       CAST("MadePublicDate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS made_public_ts,
       "IsProjectLanguageTemplate" AS is_project_language_template,
       "CurrentUrlSlug" AS current_url_slug,
       "Medal" AS medal,
       CAST("MedalAwardDate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS medal_award_ts,
       COALESCE("TotalViews",0) AS total_views,
       COALESCE("TotalComments",0) AS total_comments,
       COALESCE("TotalVotes",0) AS total_votes
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELS
views.description: One row per kernel (logical project) with author, current version refs, forum topic and engagement metrics. Use as the basis for kernel-level leaderboards, joins to versions, tags and votes. | Use for: Kernel popularity and engagement over time; Join kernels to versions, tags, and forum topics; Identify forks and lineage via fork_parent_kernel_version_id

views.name: kernelversion_to_dataset_sources
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "KernelVersionId" AS kernel_version_id,
       "SourceDatasetVersionId" AS source_dataset_version_id
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELVERSIONDATASETSOURCES
views.description: Mapping of kernel versions to source dataset versions. One row per relation; used to link kernels/versions to datasets for attribution or impact analysis. | Use for: Find which kernels used a dataset (via dataset version); Aggregate kernel counts per dataset version; Trace dataset provenance across kernels

views.name: kernels_with_current_version
views.body_sql:
SELECT k."Id" AS kernel_id,
       k."AuthorUserId" AS author_user_id,
       k."CurrentKernelVersionId" AS current_kernel_version_id,
       k."ForumTopicId" AS forum_topic_id,
       COALESCE(k."TotalViews",0) AS total_views,
       COALESCE(k."TotalComments",0) AS total_comments,
       COALESCE(k."TotalVotes",0) AS total_votes,
       kv."Id" AS version_id,
       kv."AuthorUserId" AS version_author_user_id,
       kv."VersionNumber" AS version_number,
       kv."Title" AS version_title,
       -- CreationDate in KERNELVERSIONS is NUMBER(38,0); convert from epoch seconds to TIMESTAMP_LTZ
       CASE
         WHEN kv."CreationDate" IS NOT NULL THEN TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(kv."CreationDate")
         ELSE NULL
       END AS version_creation_ts,
       COALESCE(kv."TotalLines",0) AS version_total_lines,
       COALESCE(kv."TotalVotes",0) AS version_total_votes
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELS k
LEFT JOIN META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELVERSIONS kv
  ON k."CurrentKernelVersionId" = kv."Id"
views.description: Denormalized view joining kernels to their current kernel version row (if present). One row per kernel including selected version metrics useful to answer questions about current state of kernels without scanning all versions. | Use for: Rank kernels by current version metrics; Show kernel + current version metadata in leaderboards; Filter kernels by attributes of their latest version

views.name: user_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "UserName" AS username,
       "DisplayName" AS display_name,
       TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("RegisterDate") AS register_ts,
       "PerformanceTier" AS performance_tier,
       "Country" AS country
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.USERS
views.description: Canonical user table: one row per user preserving id, display names, registration and country. Useful for user-level joins and aggregations (followers, contributions, achievements). | Use for: User-level contribution summaries; Join user demographics to kernels/submissions/achievements; Country or performance-tier segmentation

views.name: forum_topics_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "ForumId" AS forum_id,
       "Title" AS title,
       COALESCE("TotalReplies", 0) AS total_replies,
       COALESCE("TotalMessages", 0) AS total_messages,
       COALESCE("TotalViews", 0) AS total_views,
       "IsSticky" AS is_sticky,
       "FirstForumMessageId" AS first_forum_message_id,
       "LastForumMessageId" AS last_forum_message_id,
       -- CreationDate and LastCommentDate are NUMBER(38,0) per DDL: treat as epoch seconds/milliseconds.
       -- Attempt to convert using TO_TIMESTAMP_* with numeric input. If values are epoch seconds:
       -- TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ expects NUMBER as seconds; if stored as milliseconds divide by 1000.
       -- Here we defensively convert by checking magnitude: if > 10^12 assume ms else seconds.
       CASE
         WHEN "CreationDate" IS NULL THEN NULL
         WHEN ABS("CreationDate") > 1000000000000 THEN TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("CreationDate" / 1000.0)
         ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("CreationDate")
       END AS creation_ts,
       CASE
         WHEN "LastCommentDate" IS NULL THEN NULL
         WHEN ABS("LastCommentDate") > 1000000000000 THEN TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("LastCommentDate" / 1000.0)
         ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("LastCommentDate")
       END AS last_comment_ts,
       "KernelId" AS kernel_id,
       COALESCE("Score", 0) AS score
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.FORUMTOPICS
views.description: One row per forum topic with counts and last activity timestamps. Useful for forum activity summaries and joining to messages or kernels (via KernelId). | Use for: Active forum topics by messages or views; Link topics to kernels or forums; Time-to-last-comment or activity decay analysis

views.name: kernel_votes_aggregated_by_kernel
views.body_sql:
SELECT kv."Id" AS kernel_version_id,
       kv."AuthorUserId" AS version_author_user_id,
       COALESCE(kv."TotalVotes",0) AS version_total_votes,
       COALESCE(COUNT(kv_votes."Id"),0) AS votes_count_from_votes_table,
       COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT kv_votes."UserId"),0) AS distinct_voters
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELVERSIONS kv
LEFT JOIN META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELVOTES kv_votes
  ON kv."Id" = kv_votes."KernelVersionId"
GROUP BY kv."Id", kv."AuthorUserId", kv."TotalVotes"
views.description: Aggregated kernel votes per kernel version and kernel. One row per kernel (and current/kernel-version if available) with counts of votes and distinct voters. Useful for leaderboards and engagement metrics. | Use for: Compare reported TotalVotes to counted votes; Rank kernel versions by votes or distinct voters; Find versions with votes but missing TotalVotes

views.name: submissions_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "SubmittedUserId" AS submitted_user_id,
       "TeamId" AS team_id,
       "SourceKernelVersionId" AS source_kernel_version_id,
       CAST("SubmissionDate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS submission_ts,
       CAST("ScoreDate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS score_ts,
       "IsAfterDeadline" AS is_after_deadline,
       "PublicScoreLeaderboardDisplay" AS public_score_leaderboard_display,
       "PublicScoreFullPrecision" AS public_score_full_precision,
       "PrivateScoreLeaderboardDisplay" AS private_score_leaderboard_display,
       "PrivateScoreFullPrecision" AS private_score_full_precision
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.SUBMISSIONS
views.description: One row per competition submission preserving user/team, source kernel version and score timestamps. Useful as a base for leaderboard, timeliness, or per-user submission analyses. | Use for: Leaderboard construction and scoring trends; Submission timelines and late submissions analysis; Join submissions to kernel versions for provenance

views.name: user_followers_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT uf."UserId" AS user_id,
       COALESCE(COUNT(uf."Id"),0) AS follower_count
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.USERFOLLOWERS uf
GROUP BY uf."UserId"
views.description: Aggregated follower counts per user. One row per user with follower_count and following_count (how many users they follow). Useful for social-network style analyses. | Use for: Find most-followed users; Correlation of followers with contributions or achievements

views.name: forum_messages_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT "Id" AS id,
       "ForumTopicId" AS forum_topic_id,
       "PostUserId" AS post_user_id,
       TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("PostDate") AS post_ts,
       "ReplyToForumMessageId" AS reply_to_forum_message_id,
       "Message" AS message,
       "RawMarkdown" AS raw_markdown,
       "Medal" AS medal,
       TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("MedalAwardDate") AS medal_award_ts
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.FORUMMESSAGES
views.description: One row per forum message with post user, topic, timestamps and reply info. Use to analyze thread depth, reply graphs and message activity over time. | Use for: Thread analysis and reply networks; Message activity over time; Join messages to topics and votes

views.name: forum_message_votes_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT fmv."ForumMessageId" AS forum_message_id,
       COALESCE(COUNT(fmv."Id"),0) AS votes_count,
       COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT fmv."FromUserId"),0) AS distinct_voters
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.FORUMMESSAGEVOTES fmv
GROUP BY fmv."ForumMessageId"
views.description: Aggregated forum message votes per message. One row per forum message with vote count and distinct voters — useful for identifying highly-upvoted messages or users receiving votes. | Use for: Identify top voted messages; Join message votes to message and user analytics

views.name: kernel_top_versions_ranked
views.body_sql:
SELECT kv."Id" AS kernel_version_id,
       kv."AuthorUserId" AS author_user_id,
       kv."VersionNumber" AS version_number,
       COALESCE(kv."TotalVotes",0) AS total_votes,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY kv."ScriptId" ORDER BY COALESCE(kv."TotalVotes",0) DESC) AS rank_within_script
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELVERSIONS kv
views.description: Kernel-version level ranking by total votes and a dense rank per kernel. One row per kernel version including a rank per kernel (1 = highest-voted version for that kernel). Useful for selecting top version per kernel or Top-K versions downstream by filtering on rank. | Use for: Select best version per script/kernel; Top-k versions per kernel by votes

views.name: datasets_usage_by_kernelversion
views.body_sql:
SELECT kvds."Id" AS kvds_id,
       kvds."KernelVersionId" AS kernel_version_id,
       kvds."SourceDatasetVersionId" AS source_dataset_version_id,
       ds."Id" AS dataset_id,
       ds."CreatorUserId" AS dataset_creator_user_id,
       ds."OwnerUserId" AS dataset_owner_user_id,
       ds."Type" AS dataset_type,
       COALESCE(ds."TotalViews",0) AS dataset_total_views,
       COALESCE(ds."TotalDownloads",0) AS dataset_total_downloads
FROM META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.KERNELVERSIONDATASETSOURCES kvds
LEFT JOIN META_KAGGLE.META_KAGGLE.DATASETS ds
  ON kvds."SourceDatasetVersionId" = ds."CurrentDatasetVersionId"
views.description: Join mapping kernel versions to dataset versions to dataset metadata. One row per kernel-version-to-dataset (via dataset version) including dataset id and dataset-level fields. Useful to attribute kernels to dataset usage. | Use for: Which kernels reference which datasets; Aggregate kernels per dataset; Check dataset usage patterns across kernels
